title: ALPHA-ZEN daily card — THE 9
description: Nine conceptual components, eighteen independently selected signals. Each row carries an ARIF signal and a SYED signal chosen separately. Renderer: /root/AAA/scripts/alpha_zen_card.py
THE MEMORY BOUNDARY: Memory may answer: 'what is worth putting in front of this person today?'
Memory may NOT answer publicly: 'why do we know this about him?'
Selection is personalised. The reason it was selected never appears.
Both men read this card. Every line must be safe for the other to read.
Perspective A is not Perspective B: never state or imply either man's inner state.
Nothing about Syed that is not public or said by him in the shared group.
A card that shows off what the machine knows has already failed.
THE ENGINE: WEALTH  -> money, gold, market, economic consequence
WELL    -> body, workload, recovery. NEVER diagnosing the human.
GEOX    -> Earth, energy, geology, physical-reality material
HERMES  -> strip mind-reading, separate fact from inference, privacy check
arifOS  -> rank relevance + diversity; block nine versions of one subject
THE ONE RULE THAT MATTERS: Never fill a slot merely because the template demands nine. If today's random fact is rubbish, replace it from another domain. The objective is not 9 items. It is 9 reasons to stop scrolling.

headline.description: Optional one-line read. Omit rather than pad.

signals.description: THE SIGNAL CARD — what actually publishes. The 9 rows are the candidate POOL; this is the SELECTION. 4-8 lines, one sentence each, in human language. No tier name, no row number, no source string is rendered: the reader must be able to tell whose world a line belongs to from the sentence itself. F13-directed 2026-09-21 ('too chaos, signal only'). Guarded by gate G13.

who.description: Selection metadata and anchor accounting. NEVER rendered — it exists so the gate can prove both men were served, not to label the reader.

text.description: ONE sentence, max 240 chars, BM Penang, human language. No machine label, no day-count, no private marker.

source.description: Provenance. Recorded for audit; never printed on the signal card.

rows.description: The 9. Order is fixed; content is not.

arif_anchor_hit.description: Did this card carry an intelligence/Earth/wealth/institutions/meaning signal?

syed_anchor_hit.description: Did this card carry at least one BODY/gym signal AND one GOLD/trading signal? Both are required.

source.description: REQUIRED when tier is KENA_TAHU and the item is NEWS/market/deadline/event.

claim_id.description: Stable claim identity, sha256(date:mode:row:who:text)[:8] prefixed with 'az-'. Lets the night card cross-check morning claims and feed alpha_zen_to_grafema.py idempotently. Optional in input; the renderer does not require it.

quote.description: Rotates with the day's signals — not a fixed motto. A quote without real attribution does not ship.
